scientific_integrity: Analytical conjugacy, congruence-component counting, Möbius inversion, Fourier-mode arguments and standard expanding-map ergodic theory prove the stated conclusions; exact-fraction tests are supplementary. No independent review, validation or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a continuous integer-matrix torus endomorphism and its real-translation family, not digitized dynamics or noninteger matrices. Orbit-closure statements are Haar almost everywhere, not for every initial condition. General affine-toral literature might contain equivalent results not located in the documented comparisons.
title: Arithmetic periodic circles and orbit-closure dimension in an affine torus map
